title: Specialist, IT Solutions
description:
Req ID: 137066
   

  

 Region: Asia
   

  

 Country: India
   

  

 State/Province: Chennai
   

  

 City: Guindy, Chennai
   

  

 Detailed Description
   

  

* API Design and Development (Architecture \& Specs)


 Design \& Modelling: Design enterprise\-level RESTful and SOAP APIs using OpenAPI specifications (Swagger) and RAML, ensuring strict adherence to microservices architecture principles.
   

  

**Implementation:** 
 Build, configure, and publish complex APIs and loopback applications within the IBM API Connect ecosystem.
   

  

**Custom Policies:** 
 Develop advanced custom policies and gateways utilizing DataPower Extension routing, User\-Defined Policies (UDP), and custom JavaScript/GatewayScript.
   

  

* Integration \& Gateway Management (IBM DataPower)


**Gateway Configuration:** 
 Configure and maintain IBM DataPower Gateways (IDG) to handle traffic routing, throttling, message transformation (XSLT, JSON\-to\-XML), and payload validation.
   

  

**Backend Orchestration:** 
 Integrate APIs seamlessly with back\-end enterprise systems including Databases (SQL/NoSQL), and legacy SOAP web services.
   

  

* API Security \& Governance


**Security Enforcement:** 
 Implement robust API security policies including OAuth 2\.0, JWT, Mutual TLS (mTLS), SAML, and custom client authentication certificates.
   

  

**Governance \& Lifecycle:** 
 Manage the end\-to\-end API lifecycle (Drafting, Publishing, Deprecating, and Retiring) and enforce API product management principles, including rate limiting and monetization plans.
   

  

* DevOps, Deployment \& Operations


**CI/CD Automation:** 
 Build and optimize continuous integration and deployment pipelines for APIC artifacts using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, and APIC toolkits/CLI.
   

  

**Cloud Architecture:** 
 Deploy and manage APIC instances deployed on containerized environments (Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, Cloud Pak for Integration) or public cloud infra (AWS/Azure).
   

  

**Monitoring \& Analytics:** 
 Configure APIC Developer Portals and Analytics to monitor API performance, error tracking, usage metrics, and optimize payload caching.
   

  

 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
   

  

**Must\-Have Technical Skills**
**Primary Tooling:**
* Minimum 4\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on experience specifically working with IBM API Connect (including migrating or working with V10\) and IBM DataPower Gateways.
* Security Protocols: Mastery of API security standards (OAuth2, mTLS, SSL, WS\-Security).
* Coding \& Transformation: Proficient in GatewayScript, JavaScript, XSLT, XPath, and XML/JSON transformations.
* API Specs: High proficiency in writing clean OpenAPI 2\.0/3\.0 (YAML/JSON) specifications.
* Protocols: Deep understanding of REST, SOAP, HTTP/S, WebSockets, JMS.


**Nice\-to\-Have / Preferred Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with alternative API management tools (SAP PO, SAP CPI) for hybrid environments.
* Relevant IBM Certifications (e.g., IBM Certified Solution Developer \- API Connect).


**Soft Skill \& Leadership Requirements**
* Problem\-Solving: Proven ability to troubleshoot highly complex architectural, connectivity, and performance issues across distributed networks.
* Mentorship: Experience acting as a project Tech Lead, reviewing code for junior developers, and setting development standards.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical integration concepts to non\-technical stakeholders or product managers.


 Physical Demands
   

  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.


 Typical Experience
   

  

* 5 to 10 years; Experience in similar roles


 Typical Education
   

  

* Bachelor Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational Requirements may vary by Geography


 Notes
   

  

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
   

  

 Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).
   

  

 At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high\-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages.

title: Systems and Infrastructure Engineer III
description:
**About The Team**
 Walmart is seeking a Systems and Infrastructure Engineer III to support and operate the Walmart Cloud Native Platform (WCNP) — Walmart's enterprise Kubernetes platform powering thousands of cloud\-native workloads across global production environments. This is a platform support and operations role that demands strong hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, container networking, load balancing, CI/CD tooling, and observability. The successful candidate will partner closely with application teams to deliver reliable platform operations, drive automation to eliminate toil, and build AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate incident response and platform efficiency. A solid understanding of container networking, traffic management, and load balancing is essential for success in this role.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Platform Support and Operations: Serve as a primary support contact for WCNP\-hosted workloads across production and non\-production environments, managing cluster health, workload triage, incident response, and on\-call operations to meet platform SLOs.
   

  

 Cluster Build, Upgrade and Maintenance: Participate in provisioning and hardening new WCNP clusters, plan and execute cluster version upgrades with node pool rotations and control plane validations, and perform routine maintenance including node patching, certificate rotation, and etcd health checks.
   

  

 CI/CD Pipeline Support: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins/GitHub Actions equivalent, integrating compliance gates and security scans and supporting application teams in adopting Golden Path deployment standards.
   

  

 Observability and Incident Response: Troubleshoot issues using monitoring solutions using Prometheus, Grafana and OpenObserve; build dashboards and alerting rules; and produce well\-documented RCAs to drive preventive action and reduce MTTR.
   

  

 Networking and Load Balancing Support: Provide hands\-on support for container networking and traffic management — Kubernetes Services, Ingress controllers, Istio service mesh, DNS, TLS termination, and load balancer configurations — diagnosing and resolving east\-west and north\-south traffic issues.
   

  

 Configuration and Change Management: Author, validate, and manage KITT configurations (Helm\-based), Kubernetes manifests, RBAC, and network policies, coordinating all changes through ServiceNow Change Management with full version control and peer review.
   

  

 Capacity Planning and Right\-Sizing: Analyse workload resource utilisation across namespaces and node pools, and implement right\-sizing strategies, HPA/VPA configurations, and autoscaler policies to balance cost and service\-level targets.
   

  

 Security and Compliance: Implement and audit Kubernetes RBAC, Pod Security Standards, Network Policies, and secrets management; integrate container image scanning into pipelines; and support compliance reviews against PCI\-DSS, SOC2, and Walmart InfoSec standards.
   

  

 Cross\-Team Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing: Partner with application, SRE, and security teams to onboard services onto WCNP, resolve platform blockers, and contribute to run books, playbook, and platform documentation.
   

  

 Automation and DevOps: Design and implement automation pipelines using Concord and Looper to eliminate manual toil in deployments, provisioning, and remediation workflows, and build reusable Helm charts to standardise platform operations.
   

  

 AI\-Assisted Automation and Tooling Development: Develop operational tools and utilities leveraging Python scripting and AI/LLM APIs — including log analysis assistants, alert triage helpers, and run book automation agents — to reduce manual effort and improve support response quality.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field with 6\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform operations, or DevOps roles.
   

  

 Kubernetes Expertise: Deep, hands\-on experience with Kubernetes administration and operations — cluster lifecycle management, workload diagnostics, RBAC, autoscaling (HPA, VPA, Cluster Autoscaler), and multi\-cluster management. Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) preferred.
   

  

 Networking and Load Balancing: Strong understanding of Kubernetes networking — Services, Ingress controllers, CoreDNS, CNI plugins, and Network Policies. Hands\-on experience with Istio service mesh for traffic management, mTLS, and L4/L7 load balancing in containerised environments.
   

  

 Cloud\-Native Platform Knowledge: Strong experience with enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as GKE, or AKS. Familiarity with Helm for deployment configuration and internal developer platform standards.
   

  

 DevOps and CI/CD: Strong experience with CI/CD pipeline tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. Proficiency in GitOps workflows and progressive delivery strategies. Familiarity with policy\-as\-code tools like OPA or Kyverno (deployment gate system).
   

  

 Coding, Scripting, and Automation Tooling: Proficiency in Python and Bash for operational automation and tooling development. Ability to build lightweight CLI tools and automation scripts integrating with platform APIs.
   

  

 Observability: Hands\-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenObserve, or Datadog for SLO\-based alerting, operational dashboards, and log\-based health monitoring.
   

  

 Cloud Platforms: Experience with GCP or Azure, deploying and operating containerised workloads in cloud\-native environments.
   

  

 Security and Compliance: Working knowledge of Kubernetes RBAC, Pod Security Standards, Network Policies, mTLS, secrets management (Vault, ExternalSecrets), and compliance frameworks including PCI\-DSS and SOC2\.
   

  

 AI and Automation: Basic knowledge of AI/LLM API integration and prompt engineering to build operational tools such as log analysis assistants, alert triage helpers, and runbook automation agents. Curiosity to apply emerging AI capabilities to reduce operational toil.
   

  

 Incident Management: Experience in L2/L3 incident triage, root cause analysis, post\-incident reviews, and on\-call operations with a focus on reliability improvements.

 The incumbent will manage incident resolution, system maintenance, network configurations, and cloud operations, while delivering high\-quality support to internal stakeholders and customers. The role requires strong technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and adherence to operational and security standards.
 
  




**Key Responsibilities:** 
 1\. Incident \& Service Management

 ▸ Document resolutions, root causes, and updates in accordance with operational processes.
   

 ▸ Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Microsoft ecosystem and Windows server environments.
   

 2\. System Monitoring \& Infrastructure Management
   

 ▸ Proactively monitor infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog,PagerDuty).
   

 ▸ Respond to alerts across critical, warning, and error thresholds.
   

 ▸ Perform system upgrades, patch management, and scheduled maintenance activities.
   

 ▸ Manage and optimize server resources including CPU, memory, and storage capacity.
   

 3\. Network Administration
   

 ▸ Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network connectivity including static, dynamic, and failover tunnels.
   

 ▸ Perform routing updates, ASA licensing activities, and IP whitelisting tasks.
   

 ▸ Execute network security tasks such as IP blocking (shunning) and tunnel resets.
   

 4\. Identity \& Access Management (IAM)
   

 ▸ Administer Active Directory (AD) user accounts, group memberships, and access policies.
   

 ▸ Support identity synchronization between AD and Okta environments.
   

 ▸ Provision and maintain internal and customer user accounts in alignment with security policies.
   

 5\. Database Administration Support
   

 ▸ Manage database\-level access control, including granting and revoking SQL permissions.
   

 ▸ Support integration of identity groups with database systems.
   

 6\. Cloud Infrastructure (AWS) Management
   

 ▸ Configure and manage AWS services including EC2, S3, and IAM components.
   

 ▸ Monitor cloud utilization and implement cost optimization measures.
   

 ▸ Perform scheduled backups, scaling, and disaster recovery support activities.
   

 ▸ Troubleshoot infrastructure and application\-level issues within cloud environments.
   

 ▸ Integrate cloud services with on\-premises and third\-party systems.
   

 7\. Technical Support \& Troubleshooting
   

 ▸ Diagnose and resolve system performance issues, IIS services, hardware concerns, and access\-related issues.
   

 ▸ Manage service configurations, permissions, and software installations.
   

 ▸ Support authentication\-related issues including MFA resets and monitoring tool components.

 ▸ Utilize AI tools to support operational efficiency in incident analysis and reporting.
   

 ▸ Perform summarization of alerts, logs, and incident data for operational insights.
   

 ▸ Develop structured prompts for root cause analysis, escalation notes, and customer communications.

 ▸ Ensure adherence to data security and confidentiality standards when using AI tools.

title: Security Risk Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Security Engineer with strong technical acumen who can immediately design, prioritize, and implement
 **risk\-reducing technical solutions** 
 across complex cloud and enterprise environments. This role emphasizes
 **solution engineering over process engineering** 
 — using established information security frameworks, policies, and controls as direct inputs to build practical, automatable, and scalable technical safeguards.
   

  

 The ideal candidate thinks like an engineer first and a security risk professional second: someone who already understands how systems fail, how controls are enforced through code and architecture, and how risk and compliance intent translate into resilient technical designs — without requiring extended ramp\-up time on RAC fundamentals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Engineer technical risk solutions that reduce operational, cyber, and resilience risk through architecture, automation, and control design — starting on day one with minimal onboarding.
* Translate risk requirements, policies, and standards into implementable technical patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures.
* Prioritize and influence solution design decisions based on risk impact, blast radius, and recovery dependencies.
* Partner with platform, cloud, security, and SRE teams to embed risk controls directly into infrastructure and pipelines.
* Evaluate control effectiveness using technical signals and evidence, not just procedural compliance checklists.
* Independently support the requirements of internal control, internal audit, and external audit engagements, including evidence gathering, control testing, and remediation tracking.
* Deploy and manage security software, assess and apply required security patches on Security Appliances (servers).
* Support the Security Appliances 24x7 on\-call rotation to enable continuous data collection.
* Drive initiatives such as secure cloud architecture, isolated recovery environments, identity and access hardening, and infrastructure resilience.
* Provide informed, immediate guidance on risk tradeoffs and compliance requirements to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to lightweight process definition where needed, always in service of enabling better technical and audit outcomes.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Risk, Audit \& Compliance Frameworks: Direct working experience with frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOX, PCI\-DSS, or similar, and demonstrated ability to map controls to technical implementations.
* Data Analytics: Proficiency with GCP BigQuery, Power BI (or similar) for visualizing risk posture and audit evidence.
* Configuration Management / Automation: Ansible, REST API, Terraform.
* Programming / Scripting: Python, Linux Bash, Windows PowerShell, SQL.
* Cloud Platforms: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Azure, AWS.
* Supporting Knowledge (nice to have):
+ Cloud IAM, networking, and control planes
+ CI/CD pipelines and policy\-as\-code
+ Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks
+ Observability, logging, and evidence automation
+ Backup, recovery, and resilience architectures


**Required Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in security engineering, platform engineering, SRE, or technical risk roles, with a significant portion spent directly supporting risk, audit, or compliance functions.
* Demonstrated, ready\-to\-apply experience with audit lifecycles, control testing, and compliance evidence collection — able to engage with auditors and risk stakeholders immediately without extensive training.
* Proven ability to design and influence technical solutions across teams.
* Strong understanding of how risk manifests in distributed systems, cloud platforms, and automation.
* Comfortable operating at the intersection of engineering teams and risk/compliance stakeholders.
* Ability to explain complex technical risk concepts to non\-technical audiences without losing fidelity.
* Experience in production support and troubleshooting.

title: Network Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **network operations** 
 .
   

  

 We are seeking
 **Network Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s
 **global network estate — routing, DNS, CDN, and connectivity** 
 . This is a frontline operations role for engineers who watch connectivity, routing, and link health in real time and want to grow into deeper network engineering or SRE careers. You must be comfortable working a rotational shift model — including nights, weekends, and holidays — to sustain follow\-the\-sun coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Network Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle for the network tower. You monitor connectivity and routing signals, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common connectivity issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Network Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and network availability.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor network health signals — routing, DNS, CDN, links, latency, and packet loss — from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Network / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted Tier 1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood connectivity and routing issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to the Network Senior Network Engineer with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless follow\-the\-sun continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.tech or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in network operations, a NOC, or IT operations, including hands\-on network monitoring and troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing and switching, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, and CDN concepts
* Familiarity with network troubleshooting tools and techniques (ping, traceroute, packet capture, link/latency analysis)
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Networking certification (CCNA / JNCIA or equivalent)
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud networking and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Experience with L1 (physical) troubleshooting, including optical/transport and/or telecom troubleshooting
* Prior experience in a 24x7 NOC or command\-center environment, and tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. title: network engineer II
description:
**About The Team — NOC (Network Operations Center)**
 The Network Operations Center (NOC) team is responsible for the health and availability of the network infrastructure powering Walmart US Stores, Sam's Club locations, and Distribution Centers. Our team consists of 10 members operating across a follow\-the\-sun model spanning the US and India, ensuring round\-the\-clock coverage and rapid response regardless of time zone.
   

  

 At any given moment, the NOC team is the frontline safeguard ensuring that store, club, and distribution center networks remain operational — enabling associates and customers to communicate, transact, and operate without disruption. A network hiccup isn't just a technical event; it's a potential barrier to a customer's shopping experience or an associate's ability to serve them, and our team exists to prevent and resolve that impact as quickly as possible.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Identify and Troubleshoot network incidents prioritizing it based on the impact to Walmart associates and customers.
* Understand how to use monitoring tools which can help detect issues proactively and work toward a faster resolution
* Work with the urgency assigned to mitigate the issue within the SLA defined.
* Coordinate with counterpart teams to understand the details pertaining the issue and assist with resolution.
* Understand the need of the store and club business partners and work with them in tandem.
* Be crystal clear in written and oral communications. Work with US engineers and partners and handover status to US shift when India shift is over.
* Leverage the overall experience to gauge the situation and act swiftly as per the need of the hour
* Maintaining the network devices to be in compliance for efficient operation


**What You'll Bring**
* Minimum 3\-4 years of pure network engineering experience – having worked in a NOC environment or project implementation team.
* Good experience handling network hardware – routers, switches \& access points.
* Good to have \- Linux and Python/ AI automation knowledge in network space


 NOC Skillsets
   

  

 Networking background with Hands\-on experience in Routing \& Switching (CCNA/ JNCIA/CCNP).
   

  

 Strong understanding and experience working on routers, switches, APs on various platforms (Cisco, Juniper, Meraki). Such as Cisco 2900, 4K ISR, ENCS5412, Cisco 3650, 3850, 4500, 6500, 9300, Juniper EX2300, EX4600 and Meraki MS425, MS225\.
   

  

 Experience in routing protocols : RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, IS\-IS and BGP
   

  

 Strong troubleshooting skills on Juniper/Cisco and Meraki devices along with SDN knowledge.
   

  

 Understanding and troubleshooting of Switching concepts like VLAN, VTP, STP, RSTP, Ether\-Channels (PAGP \& LACP) and Stacking.
   

  

 Basic knowledge of Broadcast/ARP/MAC address
   

  

 Wired \& Wireless Networking knowledge
   

  

 Should have hands on troubleshooting experience of VLAN
   

  

 Should have implemented and troubleshooted HSRP
   

  

 Hands on experience on MPLS protocol.
   

  

 Experience in IPSEC \& DMVPN technology.
   

  

 Troubleshooting knowledge in wireless : CAPWAP, LWAPP protocols ,Cisco AP’s, Mist APs, MR46 Meraki APs and Wireless controllers.
   

  

 Usage of ticketing and troubleshooting tools like Service now and Wireshark respectively
   

  

 WLAN IEEE802\.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax Test experience
   

  

 Performance WLAN tests (preferable)
   

  

 Knowledge in Nexus, automation and SDWAN technologies is an added advantage
   

  

 Scripting Knowledge of Automation Scripts \- Python / Perl / TCL \- added advantage
   

  

 Independent Project handling with analytical ability
   

  

**Wireless ( Store \& DC )**
 Maintaining the functionality of the stores/Clubs wireless connectivity and entirety of the network at all of our distribution centres.
   

  

 Troubleshooting general wireless slowness at stores and clubs/DC’s.
   

  

 Working a wide variety of wireless escalations through outlook and Service now.
   

  

 Working on all self\-service incidents that are created by stores associates that relate to any potential wireless issues they are experiencing.
   

  

 Take calls from both associates and venders over a variety of wireless issues and push them to resolution.
   

  

 Working with store associates to power cycle any of the wireless hardware infrastructure if needed.
   

  

 Communicating with third party vendors to ensure that they have everything working on their equipment and for any equipment that needs to be replaced.
   

  

 We will also ensure that they are doing their part by getting hourly updates from them for any issues they have with their equipment
   

  

 Perform wired troubleshooting that could potentially affect wireless devices.
   

  

 Ensuring the switches power supply is giving enough POE to power on all of the access points.
   

  

 Checking DHCP Snooping on all switches and interfaces.
   

  

 Checking for DHCP/DNS errors in the ISP and ensuring that the wireless devices are receiving IP addresses.
   

  

 Performing in depth troubleshooting with members of management by having them recreate the issue while we track the device and pinpoint what exactly they are having issues with.
   

  

 Communicating with store associates for validation that they themselves and customers are able to use their personal and corporate devices without any issues or slowness.
   

  

 Validating the meshed AP in the yard of a DC are set up correctly.
   

  

 Work with the systems team at DCs to notify them of any Access points that are offline. Monitoring the store wireless environment and logistics environment.
   

  

 Monitor auto\-generated tickets for down Access points and down Internet VRFs.
   

  

 Working with Wireless controllers – Cisco (HREAP), MIST.
   

  

 Working with the wireless engineering team on certain changes to the environment.
   

  

**Wired (Store \& DC )**
 Troubleshooting packet loss, overutilization, and down circuits
   

  

 Troubleshoot any and all routing issues at store \& DC level.
   

  

 Troubleshoot voice issues, from a single extension to all the voice at site. This includes static, one\-way dialling, paging, stuck calls; and down voice gateways, and voice cards on routers.
   

  

 Troubleshoot end devices that are not receiving an IP address, not connecting, or are experiencing slowness.
   

  

 Work with third party vendors on incidents to troubleshoot and/or replace connections, cabling, and hardware.
   

  

 Working with L3 and Cisco on any TAC cases for the store wired/ voice environment.
   

  

 Working with sites to T/S down equipment before dispatching cabling and or replacements.
   

  

 Assisting Field Support on Down systems and Down Power situations.
   

  

 Monitoring overall ticket queues and making sure to maintain all tickets so that they do not go outside their SLA.
   

  

 Assisting Field Project Supervisors and Store Planners with port configurations whenever the tool fails them..
   

  

 Working with sites to troubleshoot and resolve spanning\-tree issues.
   

  

 Troubleshooting impacting DC voice issues.

title: Lead Engineer WAN & Edge Architect
description:
**About The Role**
 The backbone of TD SYNNEX's global network is routing, switching, and increasingly SD\-WAN. Across more than 100 countries, hundreds of sites, and three distinct regional engineering teams, the decisions made at the routing and switching layer \- how traffic flows, how sites fail over, how edge connectivity is managed \- touch everything. Today, those decisions are made regionally, without a global solutions\-level owner who can set direction, resolve the hardest problems, and ensure consistency.
   

  

 This role is that owner. As our Routing, Switching \& SD\-WAN Solutions Engineer based in India, you will serve as the global technical authority for network infrastructure design across all layers: campus and data center switching, WAN and carrier connectivity, and SD\-WAN edge architecture. You will design solutions for the most complex network challenges in the environment, set global standards, and act as the senior escalation point for routing and switching issues that regional teams cannot resolve on their own.
   

  

 This is a design and architecture role. You should be equally comfortable drawing a network topology, writing a technical standard, debugging a BGP route leak, and presenting a recommendation to leadership. We are not looking for someone who runs tickets \- we are looking for someone who eliminates the class of problem that generates them.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and architect routing and switching solutions for TD SYNNEX's global network \- campus LAN, WAN, data center interconnect, and SD\-WAN edge
* Serve as the global escalation point for complex routing, switching, and SD\-WAN issues \- own the problem, lead the resolution, document the fix as a standard
* Define and maintain global network design standards: topology templates, routing policy, QoS frameworks, VLAN strategy, and SD\-WAN deployment models
* Evaluate and recommend SD\-WAN architecture direction \- provider selection, edge deployment models, application\-aware routing, and zero\-touch provisioning approaches
* Review network designs for new site build\-outs, warehouse deployments, and corporate office expansions across all regions before implementation
* Partner with the Americas Network Lead, Daniel Salamanca in Europe, and the APJ engineer to align regional implementations with global standards

* 10\-15 years of enterprise network engineering experience with a strong focus on design and architecture, not just operations
* Expert\-level knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and spanning tree \- including how they interact and where they break at scale
* Hands\-on design and deployment experience with SD\-WAN platforms (Cisco Viptela/SD\-WAN, VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet, or similar)

**Nice To Have**

* Familiarity with carrier and ISP relationships \- circuit ordering, SLA management, peering

title: CloudOps Engineer III
description:
PDI Technologies is looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer III to join our CloudOps team, supporting managed cloud infrastructure for our enterprise customers on AWS. This is a senior operational role for someone who can take ownership of complex, high\-impact environments, work confidently and independently, and act as a clear communication point between customers, Professional Services, and the wider CloudOps team.
 


  


  
 


  


 You'll combine hands\-on technical delivery with strong stakeholder communication — leading incident response and change activity, running and contributing to governance and status meetings, and keeping the team informed and aligned. You'll be trusted to use your own judgement and initiative to drive issues to resolution, backed by the support and expertise of an experienced team.
 




  




**Job Responsibilities:** 
  
* Manage and support enterprise customers' cloud infrastructure on AWS, ensuring availability, performance, and security of production environments
  
* Monitor and respond to alerts via observability tooling, triaging and resolving incidents in line with agreed SLAs and SLOs.
  
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex or high\-severity issues, producing clear write\-ups and remediation actions.
  
* Carry out change management activities — including deployments, security patching, and infrastructure updates following established change control and CR governance processes.
  
* Administer and optimise AWS database infrastructure (e.g. RDS), including performance tuning, troubleshooting, and exposure/risk remediation.
  
* Support compliance and audit activity (e.g. SOC audits), ensuring operational practices meet security and regulatory requirements.
  
* Identify and help deliver cloud cost optimisation opportunities.
  
* Maintain accurate tickets, documentation, and workaround registers, and help close down accumulated technical debt
  

  



  




**Communication \& stakeholder management:** 
  
* Communicate clearly and confidently with customers, Professional Services, and internal stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
  
* Plan, schedule, and run operational and governance meetings — setting clear agendas, driving decisions, and tracking follow\-up actions to completion.
  
* Provide regular, well\-structured status updates and reporting back to the wider CloudOps team, keeping colleagues informed of progress, risks, and changes.
  
* Represent CloudOps professionally in customer\-facing forums, translating technical detail into clear, actionable communication for a range of audiences.
  

  



  




**Requirements :** 
  
* Significant experience in a Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering role, ideally within AWS environments
  
* Strong working knowledge of core AWS services (e.g. EC2, RDS) and cloud infrastructure operations
  
* Experience with monitoring/observability tooling, incident management, and change management processes.
  
* Understanding of security patching and compliance/audit processes (e.g. SOC 2\).
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence and credibility to lead meetings and communicate outcomes back to the team and to customers.
  
* Strong organisational skills and the proven ability to manage competing priorities under your own initiative.
  
* A collaborative team player who is equally comfortable working independently and knowing when to seek support from the team.
  
* Relevant AWS certification(s) desirable.
  

  



  




**Behavioral Competencies:** 
  

  
* Cultivates Innovation
  
* Decision Quality
  
* Manages Complexity
  
* Drives Results
  
* Business Insight
  

  


  





  




  



 PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. title: ASIA SSC IT Network Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
* Network Infrastructure
* Implement, configure, maintain, and support LAN and wireless network environments.
* Manage and support Cisco routers, switches, and related network infrastructure.
* Manage and support HPE Aruba wireless and network infrastructure.
* Configure and maintain FortiGate firewalls and related security infrastructure.
* Support network connectivity between production sites, offices, servers, and other infrastructure.
* Support VLAN, routing, switching, and network segmentation activities.
* Perform network capacity and performance assessments when required.
* Network Monitoring and Operations
* Monitor network infrastructure performance, availability, bandwidth utilization, latency, packet loss, and connectivity using Valeo monitoring tools such as MoVI.
* Proactively investigate monitoring alerts and network abnormalities.
* Conduct regular network health checks .
* Identify potential network issues before they impact business operations.
* Maintain high network availability and reliability.
* Perform daily network operational tasks and ensure timely resolution of issues.
* Incident Management and Troubleshooting
* Respond to network incidents according to defined SLA and operational procedures.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, and performance\-related issues.
* Analyze network logs, monitoring information, packet captures, and device diagnostic information.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major or recurring network incidents.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence.
* Escalate complex technical issues to internal teams or network equipment vendors when required.
* Firewall and Network Security
* Configure and maintain FortiGate firewall policies, NAT, routing, and security settings.
* Manage and support IPSec and SSL VPN connectivity.
* Support network segmentation and access\-control requirements.
* Review firewall rules and identify unnecessary, obsolete, or overly permissive rules.
* Support security\-related investigations and remediation activities.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to address network security vulnerabilities and incidents.
* Support endpoint/network security technologies such as Windows Defender and Trellix where required.
* Change Management
* Plan and execute network changes in accordance with Valeo Change Management procedures.
* Prepare implementation plans, test plans, validation procedures, and rollback plans.
* Perform network changes during approved maintenance windows.
* Conduct post\-change validation and confirm service availability.
* Ensure all network changes are properly documented.
* Minimize business and production impact during network maintenance activities.
* Documentation
* Maintain up\-to\-date network diagrams and infrastructure documentation.
* Maintain IP address, VLAN, subnet, routing, firewall, and network device information.
* Document network configurations, operational procedures, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Update documentation following network changes, upgrades, or infrastructure modifications.
* Create and maintain Knowledge Base articles and operational guides.
* Network Projects and Improvements
* Support network infrastructure projects, migrations, upgrades, and expansions.
* Participate in new network deployments and infrastructure improvements.
* Support network architecture and design activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to improve network performance, reliability, security, and operational efficiency.
* Support Valeo VIQCT asset improvement activities.
* Ensure network assets and configuration information are accurately maintained.
* Vendor and Service Provider Management
* Coordinate with Cisco, Fortinet, HPE Aruba, ISP, and other network equipment/service providers.
* Open and manage technical support cases with vendors.
* Provide technical information, logs, configuration data, and troubleshooting results to vendors.
* Follow up on hardware replacement, RMA, firmware issues, and technical escalations.
* Coordinate with Cisco, Fortinet, HPE Aruba, ISPs, and other network equipment/service providers.
* OJT and Knowledge Transfer
* Receive and provide OJT and knowledge transfer related to Valeo network infrastructure.
* Complete initial knowledge transfer within a minimum of 2 weeks and a maximum of 4 weeks.
* Participate in periodic OJT and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Maintain and update OJT and operational documentation.
* Participate in weekly follow\-up meetings during the initial transition period, when required.
* Demonstrate the ability to independently perform daily network operations and troubleshooting after the OJT period.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Minimum 3 years of hands\-on network engineering experience.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals.
* Practical experience in enterprise network environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco routers and switches.
* Experience with HPE Aruba wireless/network infrastructure is preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with FortiGate firewalls.
* Experience with VPN technologies, including IPSec and SSL VPN.
* Good understanding of VLAN, STP, routing, and switching.
* Working knowledge of routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP.
* Experience in network troubleshooting and incident response.
* Experience with network monitoring tools.
* Ability to analyze network logs and perform packet\-level troubleshooting.
* Experience with tools such as Wireshark is preferred.
* Understanding of network security principles and access control.
* Experience working with Change Management / ITSM processes.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in an enterprise or manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting production networks.
* Cisco certification such as CCNA or CCNP.
* Fortinet equivalent experience.
* HPE Aruba equivalent experience.
* ITIL / ITSM knowledge or certification.
* Experience with network monitoring and management platforms.
* Experience with firewall policy review and network security assessments.
* Experience with network automation or scripting is a plus.


**Valeo Support / Onboarding**
* Initial OJT and knowledge transfer: Minimum 2 weeks, maximum 4 weeks.
* Periodic OJT and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Weekly follow\-up during the initial transition period, if required.
* Review and maintain network documentation during the onboarding period.
* Gradually transition responsibilities from supervised operation to independent network management.


**Key Performance Expectations**
**The Network Engineer Is Expected To**
* Maintain stable and reliable network operations.
* Respond to network incidents within the agreed SLA.
* Minimize network downtime and business impact.
* Complete planned network changes and upgrades successfully.
* Perform effective Root Cause Analysis for significant incidents.
* Maintain accurate network documentation and configuration backups.
* Proactively identify and resolve network risks.
* Continuously improve network performance, security, and operational efficiency.
* Maintain effective communication with internal teams, users, vendors, and service providers.

title: IP Service Engineer
description:
Overview:
 




 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior IP Services Engineer with extensive experience in enterprise IP services and application delivery technologies. The ideal candidate will have 10\+ years of hands\-on experience implementing and supporting F5 BIG\-IP, Infoblox DDI, NGINX, and related IP service technologies within large\-scale enterprise and data centre environments.
 



 The role will focus on the deployment, migration, implementation, and optimisation of application delivery controllers (ADC), DNS/DHCP/IPAM (DDI), and web proxy solutions. Candidates should also possess scripting capabilities to support automation and operational efficiency, along with a strong understanding of Routing \& Switching fundamentals.
 




 Roles \& responsibilities:
 



* Deploy, configure, and implement enterprise IP Services solutions across customer environments.
* Lead F5 BIG\-IP migration projects, including migration from hardware appliances to Virtual Editions (VE/VM).
* Install, configure, and maintain NGINX web servers, reverse proxies, and load balancing solutions.
* Deploy and manage Infoblox DDI solutions, including DNS, DHCP, and IP Address Management (IPAM).
* Configure and optimise Layer 4–7 application delivery and load balancing services.
* Perform implementation, migration, and upgrade activities for enterprise IP Services infrastructure.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts to streamline deployment and operational tasks.
* Troubleshoot complex application delivery, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, and load balancing issues.
* Collaborate with Network, Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams during project delivery.
* Perform implementation validation, testing, cutovers, and post\-deployment support.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, and operational procedures.
* Participate in change management processes and ensure all implementation activities comply with customer standards.

 Mandatory Skills \& Experience:
 



* Minimum 10 years of hands\-on experience in enterprise IP Services technologies.
* Strong implementation and deployment experience with:
* F5 BIG\-IP (LTM, GTM/DNS)
* F5 Virtual Edition (VE) / Migration to Virtual Machine
* NGINX
* Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM)
* Proven experience migrating F5 appliances from physical to virtual environments.
* Strong experience configuring:
* Load Balancing
* SSL Offloading
* Virtual Servers
* Pools
* Health Monitors
* iRules (preferred)
* Experience deploying and administering NGINX as:
* Reverse Proxy
* Load Balancer
* Web Server
* API Gateway
* Strong knowledge of Infoblox DDI architecture and implementation.
* Hands\-on scripting/programming experience using one or more of:
* Python
* Bash
* Shell Scripting
* PowerShell
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
* Good understanding of Routing \& Switching fundamentals to support IP Services deployment.
* Experience working within enterprise and data centre environments.

 Good to Have:
 



* Experience with open\-source technologies and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
* Experience with Linux system administration.
* Exposure to Kubernetes, Docker, or containerised application environments.
* Experience with cloud\-based load balancing and DNS services (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Knowledge of REST APIs and API integrations.




 Preferred Certifications:
 



* F5 Certified BIG\-IP Administrator (F5\-CA)
* F5 Certified Technology Specialist (F5\-CTS)

title: Senior SecOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior SecOps Engineer**
**Location:** 
 India
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Security \& Infra Director
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly technical and hands\-on Senior SecOps Engineer to implement, operate, maintain, and continuously improve security infrastructure and tools across cloud and on\-premises environments. This role is focused on day\-to\-day security operations, including monitoring, incident response, vulnerability remediation, security assessments, and ongoing hardening of operating systems, servers, endpoints, networks, and security platforms. The engineer will be expected to perform most technical changes and remediation activities directly, while coordinating with IT, Infrastructure, SOC, Cloud, DevOps, R\&D, and application owners where alignment, approvals, dependencies, or ownership boundaries are required.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Security Infrastructure Operations
* Implement, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot security infrastructure and tools across cloud and on\-premises environments, including SIEM, XDR/EDR, vulnerability scanners, DLP, CASB, identity security, remote access, and monitoring platforms.
* Perform hands\-on configuration, administration, upgrades, tuning, rule management, policy changes, and health monitoring of security systems and supporting infrastructure.
* Maintain secure configurations and hardening baselines for Windows, Linux servers, cloud workloads, network devices, endpoints, and security appliances.
* Support deployment and lifecycle management of security tools for data centers, branch offices, cloud environments, R\&D environments, and corporate infrastructure.
* Investigate operational issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement the required technical fixes to improve stability, visibility, performance, and security coverage.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, procedures, configuration standards, and implementation guides for security systems.
* Ensure security infrastructure operates reliably and supports compliance, audit, risk management, and business continuity requirements.
* Security Monitoring \& Incident Response
* Investigate threats, respond to incidents, and perform the required technical containment, recovery, and corrective actions, while coordinating with SOC, IT, Infrastructure, and Cloud teams as needed.
* Support threat hunting, security investigations, and operational reporting based on logs, telemetry, and security tool outputs.
* Maintain and improve incident response playbooks, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Vulnerability Management \& Security Assessments
* Conduct regular security assessments across servers, operating systems, cloud workloads, endpoints, network devices, applications, and security platforms.
* Operate and improve the vulnerability management program, including scanning, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Analyze vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, exposed services, weak controls, and security gaps, and recommend practical remediation actions.
* Perform hands\-on remediation of security findings, including configuration changes, hardening, patching coordination/execution, tool policy updates, and infrastructure fixes, while coordinating with IT, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, and application owners where needed.
* Validate remediation effectiveness through rescans, configuration reviews, control testing, and follow\-up assessments.
* Automation, Improvement \& Collaboration
* Develop scripts, automation, queries, dashboards, and workflows to improve monitoring, investigations, reporting, remediation tracking, and operational efficiency.
* Implement security controls and technical improvements directly across cloud and infrastructure environments, while collaborating with cross\-functional teams on dependencies, approvals, and ownership boundaries.
* Continuously improve security operations processes, tooling, documentation, and metrics based on incidents, assessments, audit findings, and operational lessons learned.


**Qualifications**
* Experience:
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in security operations, infrastructure security, system administration, network security, cloud security, or enterprise IT security.
* Proven experience implementing, operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting security tools and infrastructure in cloud and on\-premises environments.
* Deep technical knowledge of Windows, Linux, servers, virtualization, networking, cloud platforms, identity services, endpoints, SIEM, XDR/EDR, vulnerability scanners, monitoring tools, and patch management.
* Strong experience analyzing security logs, alerts, events, and telemetry from multiple sources to identify and respond to security incidents.
* Hands\-on experience with incident response, threat investigation, containment actions, root\-cause analysis, and post\-incident remediation.
* Experience conducting security assessments, vulnerability scans, configuration reviews, hardening checks, and remediation validation.
* Experience executing hands\-on remediation activities, driving findings to closure, and coordinating with technical owners when dependencies or approvals are required.
* Strong understanding of network security, firewall policies, VPN/ZTNA, segmentation, IAM, privileged access, endpoint protection, cloud security controls, and infrastructure hardening.
* Ability to write clear operational procedures, incident response playbooks, security reports, technical documentation, and implementation guidance.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux and Windows based platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with firewalls, SIEM, XDR, CASB, DLP, EDR, vulnerability scanners, patch management, backup security, and configuration management tools.
* Experience with monitoring, automation and orchestration systems.
* Experience with securing R\&D environments.
* Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CISSP, SSCP, Security\+, CySA\+, GCIA, GCIH, GCED, CCNA/CCNP Security, Microsoft/Azure Security, AWS Security, or equivalent hands\-on experience.
* Skills:
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills in complex technical environments.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize operational tasks, and personally drive incidents, investigations, implementations, and remediation activities to closure.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical findings, risks, and remediation steps to IT, infrastructure, cloud, and security stakeholders.

You will have the opportunity to work with our global internal and external partners to drive future improvements in the performance of our technology infrastructure platforms, ensuring that we are increasing the reliability and optimizing its capacity. The overall objective is to assist with infrastructure migrations to build a secure, stable and efficient operating environment for our business to function and grow.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Provide sound understanding of technology infrastructure concepts and principles to provide support to supported platforms and sectors within technical domain.
   

  

 Apply basic understanding of how multiple areas collectively integrate within technology infrastructure to support the operations environment.
   

  

 Build, configure and tune servers as per the application requirement
   

  

 Review requirement documents, define hardware requirements and update processes and procedures as necessary.
   

  

 Co\-ordinate with various teams to resolve issues and deliver project on time.
   

  

 Provide Root Cause Analysis (RCA) post restoration of service.
   

  

 Design testing approaches, complex processes, reporting streams, and assist with the automation of repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements.

 Conduct project related research
   

  

 Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
   

  

 Handle issues and escalations, as well as resolve production problems, reporting to management on status and technical matters.
   

  

 Plan and implement improved processes, backup and recovery plans, and uniform methodologies and standards

 Work effectively with virtual and remote team members exercising critical thinking to resolve issues and presenting technical findings accurately to internal customers and leadership.
   

  

 Act as a liaison between various CTI businesses providing direction and support to resolve issues in a timely manner.

 Core Role Competencies
   

  

 Technical Knowledge: Has a recognizable area of technical competence. Familiar with appropriate standards. Applies subject domain knowledge to meet organizational need/guide actions. Keeps up with current and possible future technological developments in the field.
   

  

 Processes/ Procedures: Ensures processes and procedures are in place for self and others to use. Seeks ways to improve existing processes, making adjustments or recommending reengineering improvements.
   

  

 Customer and Industry Knowledge: Consistently applies a business driver and marketplace focus when prioritizing actions.

Evaluates controls to help mitigate negative outcomes through prevention, detection and correction. Identifies the risks of negative outcomes, including inadvertent error or fraud. Ensures ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management: Identifies key partners and their influence, implements techniques for communicating/engaging and managing expectations. Has frequent interactions. Finds the appropriate balance of completing claims by various groups of stakeholders, acting fairly and in consideration of cultural and ethical factors.
   

  

 Client Centricity: Uses insights from customer relationships to anticipate their needs and provide services beyond their expectations. Actively seeks information to understand client issues, expectations, and needs.

* Meet resolution SLA targets and provide regular, accurate updates throughout the incident lifecycle


**Root\-Cause Analysis \& Permanent Fixes**
* Determine technical root cause and distinguish symptoms from underlying causes
* Design and implement permanent fixes, configuration changes, and routing/peering adjustments within scope
* Partner with L 3 / Engineering SMEs, carriers, and transit/peering providers on architecture\-level remediation
* Validate fixes through controlled change and confirm the issue does not recur before closure


**Major Incident Response \& Technical Leadership**
* Act as technical lead on major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges, coordinating diagnosis across towers and providers
* Make and document containment, rerouting, and recovery decisions under pressure
* Serve as senior escalation point and network subject\-matter expert for the GIOC


**Reliability, Automation \& Tooling**
* Identify toil and recurring issues, and build automation to reduce manual effort and MTTR
* Improve observability — network monitoring, alerting thresholds, flow telemetry, and dashboards — to catch issues earlier
* Contribute to capacity, performance, and resilience improvements across the network estate
* Drive permanent reduction of repeat incidents through engineering and process change


**Knowledge, Runbooks \& Mentoring**
* Author and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge\-base articles that raise L1 first\-time resolution
* Mentor and coach L1 engineers; review triage quality and provide feedback
* Lead knowledge transfer and shadowing during onboarding and go\-live


**Post\-Incident Review \& Continuous Improveme** 
 nt
   

  

* Lead post\-incident reviews (PIR) and root\-cause write\-ups with clear corrective actions
* Track corrective and preventive actions to closure and measure recurrence
* Surface systemic risks and drive trend\-based reliability improvements


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\-8 years of experience in network engineering, network operations, or infrastructure operations, including Senior Network Engineers escalation and root\-cause ownership
* Deep hands\-on networking expertise — routing and switching, BGP/OSPF, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, and CDN
* Strong network troubleshooting using packet capture, flow analysis, and routing/peering diagnostics
* Proven experience leading complex incident diagnosis, root\-cause analysis, and permanent remediation
* Network automation/scripting skills (Python, Ansible, or equivalent) and familiarity with monitoring/observability and ITSM tooling
* Strong written and verbal communication for technical leadership, documentation, and mentoring; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift and on\-call model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 certification; experience with SRE or DevOps practices
* Networking certification (CCNP / JNCIP or equivalent; CCIE a plus)
* Experience with network automation (Ansible, Python, NETCONF/YANG) and CI/CD for network changes
* Exposure to large\-scale cloud networking, CDN, and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Experience with (physical) troubleshooting, including optical/transport and/or telecom troubleshooting
* Prior experience as a senior escalation resource in a 24x7 NOC or command\-center environment

title: WLAN Performance Testing - Staff Engineer
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.
* Establish performance benchmarks and release qualification criteria
* Mentor engineers, review test strategy/design and promote testing best practices
* Support customer escalations with in\-depth performance analysis.


**Required Skills \& Qualification**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in WLAN System or performance validation
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
* Automation framework development experience


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

title: Senior System Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Senior Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working a rotational shift model — including nights, weekends, and holidays — to sustain follow\-the\-sun coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Senior Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Engineers when an issue falls outside L2 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a consolidated
 **single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard,** 
 classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L2 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L2 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to L2/L3 with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 5\-8 years of experience in systems administration, NOC/SOC, or IT operations, including hands\-on Linux and/or Windows server administration
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux and/or Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC, or command\-center environment, and tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Associate Architect
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
 At Presidio, we’re at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses—and their customers—to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
   

  

**The Role**
**Strategic Ownership \& Leadership**
* Own and manage the cloud ecosystem across AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring they operate with high efficiency, strong governance, and predictable costs.
* Lead a small team of cloud engineers, guiding and coaching them in roadmap creation, prioritization, execution, and skills development.
* Act as a strategic advisor to engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders on sandbox governance, usage patterns, and optimization strategies.
* Establish and enforce policies for onboarding, offboarding, resource lifecycle, and access management for users.


**Operational Excellence \& Automation**
* Design and implement automation for sandbox provisioning, quota management, access approval workflows, scheduling, and spin\-up/spin\-down processes.
* Develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Cloud\-native tools) for repeatable lab operations.\[MS1]
* Create self\-service capabilities and guardrails for sandbox users to reduce manual effort and improve governance.
* Collaborate on lab, demo, and proof of concept engagements with internal and external stakeholders.


**FinOps, Cost Governance \& Optimization**
* Implement a FinOps\-aligned operating model for all accounts including tagging standards, cost allocation, budget enforcement, and showback/chargeback across all clouds.
* Continuously analyze cloud spend trends, forecast usage, and proactively identify opportunities for rightsizing, decommissioning, and efficiency improvements.
* Build automation for policy\-based cleanup of unused/idle resources.


**Security, Governance \& Compliance**
* Define and implement security guardrails, baseline configurations, identity/access rules, and monitoring policies for sandbox environments.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance controls and enforce boundaries between sandbox and production environments.
* Implement monitoring dashboards, alerts, and operational metrics to ensure visibility and control.


**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively introduce new approaches, tools, and technologies to make lab and demo operations more efficient, secure, and cost\-effective.
* Conduct periodic reviews of account usage patterns to identify opportunities for consolidation, automation, or architectural improvements.
* Partner with cloud providers, vendors, and internal teams to evaluate new services and establish best practices.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud operations roles, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or team lead position.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and working knowledge of the other two.
* Demonstrated experience in managing large or multi\-tenant cloud environments, including governance, account/projects/subscription management.
* Strong automation experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Understanding of Cloud Networking Concepts, such as AWS VPCs, Transit Gateways, Azure VNets, Public DNS with AWS Route 53 and VPN tunnel creation from the hyperscaler side.
* Familiarity with Cloud Compute and Storage such as EC2 Instances, Azure Virtual Machines, Google Compute Engine, AWS S3/EBS/EFS and/or Azure Disk Storage
* Proven expertise in FinOps, cloud cost governance, and optimization frameworks.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, guardrails, monitoring, and policy management.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.

 VCN \& Subnets \| Client \& Backup Networks \| NSGs \| Security Lists \| Route Tables \| DRG \| DNS/SCAN \| FastConnect \| Site\-to\-Site VPN \| OCI IAM \| Vault/KMS \| OCI Monitoring \| Alarms \| Object Storage \| TDE
   

  

 The candidate should be capable of troubleshooting application\-to\-database, RAC, on\-premises\-to\-OCI and network latency/connectivity issues.
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
   

  

**Experience Supporting Large Enterprise Oracle Database Environments Is Required.**
