This role places you at the heart of our digital transformation journey, delivering best\-in\-class Public Key Infrastructure services that enable our business units to build, deploy, and operate secure applications with confidence. Your expertise will underpin the assurance standards that empower our stakeholders worldwide, ensuring uninterrupted business continuity and regulatory compliance.

* Design, review, and maintain certificate templates that meet current and anticipated business requirements while aligning with security best practices.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including architecture, policies, operational procedures, and configuration standards to ensure knowledge continuity and audit readiness.
* Conduct periodic PKI health assessments, monitor system performance and capacity, and validate disaster recovery processes to ensure resilient service availability.
* Analyze security incidents and conduct vulnerability assessments, applying risk\-based approaches to inform security controls and tolerance decisions.
* Contribute actively to the governance framework, ensuring alignment with risk and audit requirements to uphold the integrity of the Bank’s cybersecurity infrastructure.
* Communicate effectively across all organisational levels, providing clear, concise updates and technical insights to both senior leadership and hands\-on practitioners.


**Skills And Experience**
**Core Skills and Experience:**
* A minimum of eight years’ experience in data security with a focus on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate management, demonstrating hands\-on expertise.
* Comprehensive knowledge of cryptographic key management principles and hardware security modules (HSM).
* Proven experience administering Microsoft PKI solutions at scale, including Root Certification Authorities, Subordinate CAs, OCSP responders, and certificate revocation infrastructure.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards such as PCI\-DSS, alongside practical expertise in tokenization, data masking, and data dispersion techniques.


**Additional Technical Competencies**
* Programming skills in languages such as Java or Python to support automation, integration, and tooling development associated with certificate management.
* Ability to apply security assessment methodologies and perform vulnerability analyses related to encryption and PKI environments.


 Demonstrated capacity to work within complex organisational structures and effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders is essential for success in this position.

 At Standard Chartered, we value individuals who approach their work with integrity and courage, embodying our principle to 'Do the right thing.' We encourage our team members to be resilient agents of change, thinking client\-first and embracing continuous innovation. Motivated professionals who seek to uphold ethical standards while driving security excellence thrive in our environment. If you have a passion for contributing meaningfully to a global institution’s security posture and cherish collaborative, principled leadership, this role will offer a fulfilling platform to realise your ambitions.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Experience:**
* Proven experience managing Public Key Infrastructure and cyber security infrastructure components at an enterprise level.
* Relevant professional certifications including Microsoft PKI Specialist, CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), and CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) are highly desirable.


**Language Proficiency**
* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English are required to engage effectively with international teams and document critical security procedures.


 Candidates with additional certifications or experience in risk management frameworks and cloud security technologies will be considered favourably.
   

  

**About Standard Chartered**

We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**

* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

**What We Offer**

 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Manager, IT Systems Administration
   

  

**Contract:** 
 Permanent, Full\-time
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.
   

  

 While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**
* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends


**Cloud Security**
* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments


**Cloud Networking**
* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures


**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**
* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed


**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**
* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments


**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**
* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records


**Minimum**
**What You’ll Need:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.


**Your Advantage**
* Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with IT service management practices (ITIL) and change management processes

title: System Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working on a rotational shift model (24x7\) — including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure we have full coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Systems Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to Senior Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in systems administration, preferably in NOC/SOC, or IT operations
* Good understanding of Linux/Windows
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux/Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, Hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior working experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC or Command\-Center environment
* Experience in using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Associate Director- Protection & Control
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 Jacobs is a global provider of technical, professional, and scientific services including engineering, architecture, construction, operations, and project management. Our portfolio spans industrial, commercial, and government clients across multiple markets and geographies. We have a PAN\-India presence, with world\-class engineering delivery centres in Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Chennai and Kolkata.
   

  

 Challenging Today…Reinventing Tomorrow.
   

  

 Jacobs is seeking a
 **Associate Director\- Protection \& Control** 
 to support a range of high\-profile projects across our Power \& Energy portfolio. In this role, you will serve as a global Subject Matter Expert – Protection \& Control, IEC 61850 \& Digital Substations providing advanced technical leadership for protection and control engineering across substations, transmission and distribution systems, renewable interconnections, industrial power networks and digital grid infrastructure.
   

  

 The SME will act as a technical authority for conventional, hybrid and fully digital substations, supporting projects across global markets including UK, Australia, Middle East, Europe, North America and Asia\-Pacific. The role requires deep domain expertise in protection schemes, relay settings, substation automation, IEC 61850 integration, SCADA interfaces, cybersecurity, commissioning support and future\-ready digital substation technologies.
   

  

**The Primary Responsibilities Would Be**
**Protection \& Control Engineering**
* Provide specialist technical leadership for protection and control design of medium voltage, high voltage and extra high voltage substations.
* Lead, review and technically assure protection schemes for
+ Line protection
+ Transformer protection
+ Busbar protection
+ Breaker failure protection
+ Feeder protection
+ Capacitor bank and reactor protection
+ SVC / STATCOM protection
+ Renewable and BESS interconnection protection
+ Industrial power network protection
+ Grid connection and interconnection protection

* Lead and review key engineering deliverables including
+ Protection Single Line Diagrams / Key Line Diagrams
+ Protection and control schematics
+ Control logic diagrams
+ Trip and alarm matrix
+ AC/DC auxiliary schematics
+ Panel GA and BOQ
+ Wiring diagrams
+ Interface drawings
+ Interconnection schedules
+ Cable schedules
+ Relay assembled forms
+ Test and commissioning documentation

* Provide expert review of relay setting calculations and protection coordination studies.
* Review and approve relay settings, protection philosophies, technical reports and protection coordination documents.
* Provide technical direction for distance protection, differential protection, overcurrent protection, earth fault protection, REF, synchro\-check, auto\-reclose, breaker failure and busbar protection applications.
* Support fault level studies, protection grading, grid code compliance and system performance validation.
* Provide technical support during FAT, SAT, commissioning, energization and post\-energization troubleshooting.
* Review vendor drawings, relay configuration files, test procedures, test reports and as\-built documentation.


**IEC 61850 Integration and Digital Substations**
* Lead advanced engineering for IEC 61850\-based digital substations, including concept design, detailed design, configuration strategy, integration, testing and commissioning support.
* Define and review complete digital substation architecture including
+ Station bus
+ Process bus
+ Protection IEDs
+ Merging units
+ SCADA gateways
+ HMI systems
+ Engineering workstations
+ Network switches
+ Time synchronization systems

* Provide expert guidance on IEC 61850 applications including
+ GOOSE messaging
+ MMS communication
+ Sampled Values
+ Logical nodes and data modelling
+ Dataset configuration
+ Report control blocks
+ GOOSE control blocks
+ Sampled Value control blocks
+ Multi\-vendor interoperability

* Lead preparation and review of IEC 61850 deliverables including
+ IEC 61850 architecture drawings
+ Communication architecture
+ IED capability assessment
+ Signal lists and data point schedules
+ GOOSE mapping schedules
+ MMS mapping schedules
+ Sampled Value design documents
+ Logical node mapping
+ ICD, CID, IID, SCD and SSD file review records
+ FAT/SAT procedures for IEC 61850 systems

* Provide expert review and validation of IEC 61850 configuration files and ensure consistency between drawings, relay configuration, automation configuration and SCADA mapping.
* Lead or support multi\-vendor integration involving Siemens, Hitachi Energy / ABB, GE Vernova, Schneider Electric, SEL, NR Electric and other global OEMs.
* Support digital substation testing using tools such as Omicron, Doble, Wireshark, IEDScout, StationScout, IET600, DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista and equivalent platforms.
* Guide project teams on migration from conventional hardwired systems to hybrid or fully digital substation architecture.
* Develop digital substation templates, standard architectures, reusable design libraries and configuration governance processes.


**Substation Automation, SCADA and Communication Networks**
* Provide technical leadership for substation automation systems, SCADA integration, RTU/Gateway interfaces, HMI systems and control centre communication.
* Review communication protocols and interfaces including IEC 61850, IEC 60870\-5\-101/104, IEC 60870\-5\-103, DNP3, Modbus, OPC UA, SNMP and synchrophasor interfaces where applicable.
* Lead design and review of digital substation communication networks including
+ Ethernet LAN architecture
+ Managed switch configuration philosophy
+ VLANs and IP addressing
+ Multicast management
+ PRP / HSR redundancy
+ Network segmentation
+ Remote engineering access
+ Network monitoring and diagnostics

* Provide guidance on time synchronization systems including IEEE 1588 PTP, SNTP, IRIG\-B and GPS\-based time sources.
* Review communication architecture for high availability, resilience and reliable operation of critical protection and control systems.


**Cybersecurity Considerations**
* Provide technical leadership on cybersecurity requirements for protection, control, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across the engineering lifecycle from concept design through commissioning and handover.
* Review designs against relevant cybersecurity standards and requirements such as IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP where applicable, utility standards and client\-specific cybersecurity requirements.
* Provide guidance on secure substation architecture including
+ Network segmentation
+ Defense\-in\-depth design
+ Secure remote access
+ Role\-based access control
+ User authentication
+ Password and credential management
+ Firewall and gateway interface requirements
+ Secure engineering access
+ Logging and event monitoring
+ Asset inventory
+ Patch and firmware management considerations
+ Backup and recovery strategy
+ Configuration file control
+ IED, gateway, HMI and workstation hardening

* Define cybersecurity requirements for vendors and OEMs during specification, procurement, FAT, SAT and commissioning stages.
* Support cybersecurity risk reviews for IEC 61850 systems, SCADA links, remote access, vendor interfaces and third\-party equipment.
* Promote secure\-by\-design principles for digital substations, renewable plants and future grid automation systems.


**Renewable Energy, Grid Connection And Future Capabilities**
* Provide SME support for solar, wind, battery energy storage, hybrid renewable plants, collector substations and grid interconnection facilities.
* Support protection design for inverter\-based resources, weak grids, low fault current networks and changing grid behaviour.
* Provide technical guidance on grid code compliance for renewable interconnections across different countries and regions.
* Support future capability development in
+ Digital substations
+ Process bus implementation
+ Centralized protection systems
+ Virtual protection and control concepts
+ Wide Area Monitoring, Protection and Control
+ Synchrophasor\-based applications
+ Digital twin for substations
+ Model\-based engineering
+ Automated relay setting workflows
+ AI\-assisted engineering checks
+ Cloud\-based asset monitoring
+ Predictive maintenance
+ Cyber\-secure remote commissioning
+ Standardized global digital substation delivery models


**Technical Assurance, Quality and Delivery**
* Act as the highest level of technical support for complex protection, control, automation and digital substation issues.
* Provide independent technical review, design assurance and quality validation for critical deliverables.
* Ensure engineering outputs comply with client specifications, utility standards, grid codes, IEC, IEEE, CIGRE recommendations, regional requirements and Jacobs quality procedures.
* Support project execution plans, design criteria, risk registers, assurance plans and quality review processes.
* Support resolution of client queries, technical deviations, design changes, non\-conformances and site issues.
* Work with Design Project Engineers, Project Managers and global delivery teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to expected quality standards.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of technical, commercial, schedule, risk, HSEC and quality aspects of projects.


**Client, Proposal and Capability Development**
* Lead technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs, contractors and global project teams.
* Support proposals, bids, tenders, technical estimates, capability statements and technical bid evaluations.
* Manage technical relationships and build appropriate level contacts with key clients.
* Strengthen client relationships through technical excellence, practical problem solving and high\-quality project delivery.
* Mentor Lead Engineers, Senior Engineers, Graduate Engineers and design teams.
* Develop internal capability through training, technical sessions, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
* Create and maintain technical standards, design guides, checklists, templates, automation workflows and best\-practice documents.
* Drive innovation, digital delivery, standardization and future\-ready engineering practices across the Protection \& Control discipline.


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* BE / B Tech / ME / M Tech in Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum 18\+ years of experience in Protection \& Control engineering, substation automation, digital substations or associated power system engineering.
* Strong experience in MV, HV and EHV substation protection and control systems.
* Experience with substations up to 400kV / 765kV and above is desirable.
* Proven experience supporting international utility, renewable, industrial and grid connection projects.
* Expert knowledge of protection philosophies, relay applications, control systems, SCADA integration, substation automation and digital substation technologies.
* Strong experience in IEC 61850 design, configuration review, integration, testing and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity requirements for protection, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ability to interpret international standards, utility requirements, client specifications and grid codes.
* Excellent technical report writing, communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to act as a global technical authority, mentor teams and support capability growth across the business.


**Mandatory Skill Sets**
* Expert\-level knowledge of Protection \& Control engineering for substations, T\&D systems, renewable interconnections and industrial power networks.
* Strong knowledge of protection schemes, relay setting calculations, relay configuration, protection coordination and testing.
* Advanced knowledge of IEC 61850 including station bus, process bus, GOOSE, MMS, Sampled Values, logical nodes, datasets, control blocks and SCD file management.
* Strong understanding of digital substation architecture, IED integration, communication networks and multi\-vendor interoperability.
* Strong awareness of cybersecurity standards and secure\-by\-design principles.
* Strong technical assurance, quality review and independent design checking capability.
* Ability to lead complex technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs and global project teams.
* Experience supporting FAT, SAT, commissioning and troubleshooting of protection, control and digital substation systems.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to articulate clear technical direction.


**Preferred Skill Sets**
* Experience with tools such as DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista, Easergy Studio, AcSELerator, IET600, Omicron Test Universe, StationScout, IEDScout, Doble and Wireshark.
* Experience with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, MicroStation, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD or PSS/E.
* Experience in Australia, UK, Middle East, Europe, US or other international utility projects.
* Experience in solar, wind, BESS, hybrid renewable plants and grid interconnection projects.
* Experience with IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP or utility cybersecurity frameworks.
* Knowledge of PRP, HSR, VLANs, multicast traffic management, PTP, SNTP, IRIG\-B and network resilience requirements.
* Experience in model\-based engineering, digital twin, automation workflows or data\-centric engineering delivery.
* Basic understanding of Python or scripting for engineering process improvement is preferred.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

GIS develops the bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, identifies and addresses vulnerabilities and operates a global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents. Within GIS, the Cloud Security organization is responsible for leading a team of deeply technical cyber security engineers and architects to design and implement best in class cyber security capabilities for internal and external cloud instances in partnership with infrastructure and application technology teams. In addition, lead efforts across other Global Information Security functions to enable cyber security technology and operations in cloud environments.

* Hands\-on experiences in coding

You’ll also have opportunities for career growth as you learn and apply new skills with various technologies to support the organization's objectives.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Performing triage, fault isolation, and remediation of Network events.
* Developing your professional skills and technical knowledge through on\-the\-job experience and training.
* Partnering with senior engineers to provide timely and accurate technical assistance to our internal and external customers.
* Applying acquired technical knowledge to monitor and troubleshoot issues, ensuring the health of the network while working closely with external and internal organizations
* Providing on\-demand support to eliminate unexpected service impacts to our customers based on the needs of the business. (Our customers may include customer service centers, technical support organizations, and executive management teams during network events and major outages.)


**What We’re Looking For…**
 You’re a motivated self\-starter and quick learner who thrives in a fast\-paced environment. You meet all new challenges with a commitment to quality and team collaboration. You are flexible, dependable, and work well in varying environments.
   

  

**You’ll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree or One or more years of related work experience.
* Ability to work 24/7 operational schedule, including night shifts, weekends, and designated holidays, in alignment with operational requirements.
* Experience working in a customer service setting.
* Expertise in managing customer communications and telephone interactions.


**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**
* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or any other related discipline
* Knowledge of LTE networks and 4G to 5G technologies.
* Experience in troubleshooting and/or telecommunications.
* Knowledge of Cloud and Virtualized solutions (OpenStack/ VMWare).
* Network certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, or similar).
* Scripting with Python, No\-JS, Perl, or equivalent languages.
* Experience in computer support experience, including troubleshooting PC hardware and configurations.
* Ability to work in a high\-pressure, dynamic environment and adjust to priority changes
* Ability to work well in a team environment.

title: Senior Administrator, Systems
description:
**Title**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Senior Administrator, Systems
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for overseeing and providing the installation, maintenance, support and enhancement to the Company computing infrastructure. Areas of responsibility include Windows and Linux Operating Systems , Active Directory , Azure/Entra, Office365, VMWare, Backup and Cloud technologies. The Senior Systems Administrator recommends technology decisions to Management and directs operational processes to Systems Administrators for the ICU Medical Global Computing environment.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Create the Architecture; implement, configure, and support all enterprise computing systems globally.
* Create standards and documentation for the Global computing environments.
* Participate in creating and following the directives in the Infrastructure Strategic plan.
* Adhere to all Service Level Agreements established with the user community.
* Create reports and establish operational guidelines for the Global Computing Environments.
* Create automated monitoring to alert Systems Administrators and Service Desk staff of disruptions of service.
* Participate in vendor management under the direction of the department manager.
* Architect, implement, and support virtual and standalone server and storage solutions.
* Benchmark, evaluate and make recommendations for the selection of server and storage management software and hardware products.
* Develop and implement business continuity practices for server and storage management.
* Monitor server and storage performance, diagnose server issues, and perform emergency and scheduled maintenance.
* Provide support to operations relating to server and storage administration problems.
* Maintain server and storage configurations to provide performance monitoring/tuning of enterprise environments.
* Keep the Information Systems staff and customers informed of the status and resolution of issues; update the Service Desk software with resolutions and status.
* Participate in strategic initiatives by performing technical project activities.
* Evaluate server system and storage upgrades and management software patches.
* Prepare monthly status reports (or implement web\-based reports) quantitatively reporting server and storage capacity, performance and uptime.
* Responsible for securing server and storage resources including password maintenance, new user logon and setup, and data protection procedures.
* Create and maintain automated systems and procedures for storage and server operations.
* Assist Service Desk staff in streamlining daily operations.
* Coordinate with user community scheduling times and user procedures necessary for server and storage system upgrades and/or maintenance.
* Work to minimize downtime impact on users through accurate planning of scheduled downtimes and quick problem resolution for unscheduled downtimes.
* Follow the established standards for writing and documenting projects and server and storage configurations.
* Contribute to the development of new standards and/or the modification of existing standards.
* Participate in the 24/7 department on\-call program.
* Work on special assignments as they arise.


**Knowledge \& Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Operating Systems
* Strong knowledge of Office 365 environments
* Experience with PowerShell and using scripting to automate configuration management
* Experience with automation platforms such as SCORCH, MoveIT Automate, VMWare Orchestrator
* Experience with Azure cloud services
* Experience with DFS, CIFS, and print services
* Experience with VDI technologies. Preferably RDS and Horizon
* Experience with MSSQL and basic MSSQL management functions
* Strong knowledge in supporting enterprise backup solutions and troubleshooting backup issues
* Strong knowledge of data center technologies; Virtualization, Storage, Servers
* Understanding or experience supporting .Net application servers
* Knowledge of budget reductions, standardized processes, and operational automation.
* Strong customer service skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent collaboration skills and able to work in a team environment
* Able to work quickly and effectively under pressure and to efficiently handle multiple priorities simultaneously


**Minimum Qualifications, Education \& Experience**
* Must be at least 18 years of age
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related IT field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in server/user administration, virtualization and storage in a global enterprise environment
* Microsoft certification preferred
* Strong experience in virtual/physical server and storage technologies
* Experience in developing and implementing business continuity and disaster recovery practices
* Experience in data backup technologies
* Experience planning and leading global small to medium scale server related projects


**Work Environment**
* This is largely a sedentary role.
* This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment.
* Typically requires travel less than 15% of the time.
